description: Land Title Settlement Department - Indibedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520203
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, property ownership determinations, and land-related legal declarations.
